teaser.en: So new to Digo farms that it never got a name of its own: it is simply 'tubers'.
teaser.sw: Ni zao geni mno katika mashamba ya Wadigo kiasi kwamba halikupata jina lake lenyewe: huitwa tu 'viazi'.
teaser.dg: Ni viphya sana kpwenye minda ya Adigo hata taviphaha dzina ravyo: vinaihwa tu 'viazi'.

summary.en: Viazi, the Irish potato, is a recent arrival in Digo farming. It is known by the general word for root tubers, because it came too late to earn a name of its own.
summary.sw: Viazi, au viazi mviringo, ni zao lililoingia karibuni katika kilimo cha Wadigo. Hujulikana kwa neno la jumla la viazi vya mizizi, kwa sababu lilifika kuchelewa mno kupata jina lake lenyewe.
summary.dg: *Viazi*, ambavyo kpwa Chingereza ni *Irish potato*, ni mmea mphya kpwenye chirimo cha Adigo. Vinaihwa kpwa neno ra kawaida ra viazi vya mizi, kpwa sababu vyedza bada ya mimea yanjina, na taviphaha dzina ravyo.

about.en: The Irish potato is a soft-stemmed, leafy plant of the tomato family, with leaves divided into leaflets and white to purple flowers. Its food is the tuber, a swollen underground stem with 'eyes' from which new shoots grow.
about.sw: Kiazi mviringo ni mmea wenye shina laini na majani mengi wa familia ya mnyanya, wenye majani yaliyogawanyika kuwa vijani na maua meupe hadi ya zambarau. Chakula chake ni kiazi, shina lililovimba lililo chini ya ardhi lenye 'macho' ambamo machipukizi mapya huota.
about.dg: Viazi ni mmea wenye milita milaini na makodza manji, wa jamii ya nyanya. Makodzage ganaganyika kukala makodza madide, na maruwage ni ga rangi nyereru hadi zambarau. Seemu inayoriwa ni chiazi, muhi wa tsini uriofutuka, wenye 'matso' (*dzitso*) ambago mitse miphya inamera kula kpwago.

where.en: Potatoes do best in the cool highlands, and most of those eaten on the coast come from upcountry. Pakia notes that Digo farmers grow some tuber crops, including potatoes, on terraces and in home gardens.
where.sw: Viazi mviringo hustawi vizuri zaidi katika nyanda za juu zenye baridi, na vingi vinavyoliwa pwani hutoka bara. Pakia anabainisha kwamba wakulima Wadigo hupanda baadhi ya mazao ya viazi, ikiwemo viazi mviringo, kwenye matuta na katika bustani za nyumbani.
where.dg: Viazi vinamera vinono zaidi kpwenye tsi za dzulu za bara zenye mnyevu, na vinji kahi ya viazi vinavyoriwa pwani vinarehwa kula bara. Pakia anaandika kukala akurima a Adigo anaphanda mimea yanjina ya viazi, phamwenga na viazi hivi, kpwenye matuta na minda ya kaya.

uses.en: The tubers are boiled, fried and cooked in stews, and are a common part of coastal meals, from chips to *biriani*.
uses.sw: Viazi huchemshwa, hukaangwa na hupikwa katika michuzi, na ni sehemu ya kawaida ya milo ya pwani, kuanzia chipsi hadi *biriani*.
uses.dg: Viazi nkuchemushwa, nkukalangwa na nkujitwa kpwa mtsuzi, na ni seemu ya kawaida ya chakurya cha pwani, kula *chips* hadi *biriani*.

culture.en: Pakia explains that the Digo name root tubers by species: *manga* for cassava, *myogwe* for sweet potato, *nduma* for arrowroot. The Irish potato came later and had no name, so it took the general word for tubers. The eyes on a potato are called *dzitso*, the same word as the scar on a bean and the marks on a coconut.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huvipa viazi vya mizizi majina kulingana na spishi: *manga* kwa muhogo, *myogwe* kwa kiazi kitamu, *nduma* kwa nduma. Kiazi mviringo kilikuja baadaye na hakikuwa na jina, kwa hivyo kilichukua neno la jumla la viazi. Macho ya kiazi huitwa *dzitso*, neno lilelile linalotumika kwa kovu la harage na alama zilizo kwenye nazi.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala Adigo nkuiha viazi vya mizi kpwa aina zao: *manga* (muhogo), *myogwe* (viazi vitamu) na *nduma* (arrowroot). Viazi vya Chizungu vyedza bada na kala taviphaha dzina, kpwa hivyo vikahala neno ra kawaida ra viazi. Matso ga chiazi nkuihwa *dzitso*, neno ririro sawa na ra alama iriyo kpwenye tembe ya kunde na alama za nazi.

names.en: Pakia records *viazi*, a plural, for the Irish potato; the same word also covers wild root tubers in general. The singular *chiazi* is a collective term for root tubers, and the Mgombato dictionary gives *chiazi* simply as 'potato'. In Swahili it is *kiazi*, plural *viazi*, often *viazi mviringo* to tell it from the sweet potato.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *viazi*, neno la wingi, kwa kiazi mviringo; neno hilohilo pia hujumuisha viazi vya mizizi vya porini kwa jumla. Umoja wake *chiazi* ni neno la jumla la viazi vya mizizi, na kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *chiazi* tu kama 'potato'. Kwa Kiswahili ni *kiazi*, wingi *viazi*, mara nyingi *viazi mviringo* ili kukitofautisha na kiazi kitamu.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *viazi*, neno ra unji, kpwa viazi vya Chizungu; neno ihi ihi nkuhumirwa piya kpwa viazi vyosi vya mizi vya tsaka. *Chiazi* (umwenga) ni neno ra kawaida ra viazi vya mizi, na Mgombato unalavya *chiazi* kukala 'potato' tu. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *kiazi*, unji *viazi*, mara nyinji *viazi mviringo* kuvitafwautisha na viazi vitamu.

definition.en: The eye buds of the Irish potato, from which new shoots grow.
definition.sw: Vichipukizi vya macho vya kiazi mviringo, ambavyo machipukizi mapya huota kutoka kwavyo.
definition.dg: Matso ga chiazi, ambago mitse miphya inamera kula kpwago.
